title: Story premise EDU021: The Maze With a Waiting Line
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (computing/data). Hook: Which square should the robot visit next? Takeaway/theme: Breadth-first search explores unweighted routes in increasing edge count.
description: A search robot wants the shortest route through an unweighted tile maze, but repeatedly chases the most tempting corridor. Expanding a first-in-first-out frontier one layer at a time finds a shortest route.
